What's New in v1.0.4 (52)

  • 📝 Description: Ready for macOS 26 Tahoe! Better sidebar, now you can reorder layouts, plus improved app stability and reliability.
  • ✨ New: Fully compatible with macOS 26 Tahoe – Modoki looks stunning with new Liquid Glass interface elements and seamlessly blends with the new macOS aesthetic.
  • ✨ New: Reorder layouts in sidebar – simply drag any layout in the sidebar to organize them perfectly for your workflow.
  • 🛠️ Fix: Fixed issues with license activation on macOS 26 Tahoe.
  • 🛠️ Fix: Multiple minor bug fixes... you might not even notice them! But they were there.
  • 📈 Improvements: Improved app stability and reliability – providing a smoother and better experience.
  • 📈 Improvements: Better system integration and performance optimizations.

    • Full Changelog
